name: PinkPlate_FOOD23

axes.description: 180 degrees about native X. Native (x,y,z) -> Blender (x,-y,-z); native negative Z is dish-up. Inverse is the same rotation.

baselineSafetyBoundary.interpretation: Measured current baseline safety bands, not anime-derived required dimensions. Only the two existing upper rings are initially editable; all other source positions remain fixed.
baselineSafetyBoundary.classification: Radius rounded to nearest micrometre solely to identify the existing Float32 rings; exact native coordinates stay unchanged.
baselineSafetyBoundary.normalUvRule: Preserve the original N/T/UV0 in this input. Candidate changes require local geometry-consistent normals and smooth boundary validation; no unrelated whole-model recalculation.

allowedCandidateScope: Only the upper inner-boundary to broad-rim cross-section of this pink dish. Preserve centre contact patch, underside, outer diameter, outer lip, pivot, axes, units and placement. Keep this original UV0/N/T evidence; any candidate normal/UV work must be confined to actually changed geometry and separately validated.
boundary: This is current geometry input, not an improved candidate, native integration or lilToon appearance certification.
